    About these words

    Draft for review · Adapted from your GRE-341-LIST-NEW PDF. Repeated entries are merged; inflected verbs are generally listed under their base form. Explicit comparison words are included. Sections follow the PDF's broad order rather than alphabetical order.

    Tags identify the original PDF lists. The 160+ tag comes from its hard-section lists (Sets 1–15); the separately headed New Words 2023 is tagged separately. A word can belong to multiple source lists. These are source labels, not independently verified difficulty or score guarantees. Within 160+, Basic groups more familiar or straightforward words, while Advanced groups rarer words or subtler senses. This is a suggested study order, not a classification from the PDF.

    Meanings were reviewed and rewritten; questionable definitions received targeted dictionary checks. These are selected study senses, not exhaustive dictionary entries. Synonyms and opposites depend on context. Mnemonics are invented memory cues, not claims about word origins.

    Needs your confirmation: no unresolved source wording prevents study. Roman Urdu spelling is flexible; tell me if you prefer a different phrasing.

    Dictionary checks: valid, avert, ebb, harrow, disseminate, polarize, cavalier, ratiocinate, suppleness, levity, subjective, erroneous, obeisance, synergy, fortuitous, symbiosis, circumstantial, prehensile, discursion, exorable, ravel, voluble.

    This file contains the full app. Reading and navigation work offline; dictionary links need internet. No account, tracking, or external assets.

    Section 01

    Word 001 / 878

    Covet

    High frequency · Set 3Confusing words
    • Meaning

      Desire something strongly, especially another person's possession.

    • Word breakdown

      covet = cover it with desire: wanting something that belongs to someone else.

    • Example

      She coveted her colleague's award.

    • Mnemonic

      ENGLISHA trophy behind a glass cover: you want it for yourself.

      ROMAN URDUDoosre ki trophy dekh kar: kaash meri hoti!

    • Synonyms

      crave, yearn for

    • Antonyms

      scorn

    Next word →
    ‹ Word list
    Section 01

    Word 002 / 878

    Covert

    Confusing words
    • Meaning

      Secret or concealed.

    • Word breakdown

      covert = covered: hidden from view or done secretly.

    • Example

      They conducted a covert investigation.

    • Mnemonic

      ENGLISHCovered operations stay covert.

      ROMAN URDUParde ke peechhe chhupa hua kaam.

    • Synonyms

      clandestine, hidden

    • Antonyms

      overt

    ← PreviousNext word →
    ‹ Word list
    Section 01

    Word 003 / 878

    Convulsion

    High frequency · Set 3Confusing words
    • Meaning

      A violent involuntary muscle movement; a violent upheaval.

    • Word breakdown

      convulsion = con + vuls + ion: con = together; connect it to violent involuntary muscle movement.

    • Example

      The revolution caused political convulsions.

    • Mnemonic

      ENGLISHPicture a country shaking like a body.

      ROMAN URDUJism ya mulk ko zor ka jhatka.

    • Synonyms

      spasm, upheaval

    • Antonyms

      stability (figurative)

    ← PreviousNext word →
    ‹ Word list
    Section 01

    Word 004 / 878

    Contravene

    High frequency · Set 2Confusing words
    • Meaning

      Violate a rule or contradict a principle.

    • Word breakdown

      contravene = contra + venue: go against the rules of the venue.

    • Example

      The policy contravenes the agreement.
